Mono, nice to meet you!

My name is Rain and I am an individual vtuber!
Could you please paint a picture of Rain? She is a bird and the manager of the government's alchemy department. She is smart and cute. She loves green, iced coffee and idle games! Rain is a parrot (lovebird).
If you don't mind, I would also appreciate a transparent version for social networking distribution.

Thank you for your consideration. (*^▽^*)

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1s-OsFFlL-BqzheUuoiP4zTVDfjuKGj7Y?usp=sharing

Hello!! Mono先生 has such wonderful drawings I am very happy! So I would like to put in a request! 

I am new to skeb, so I apologize if I made a mistake or for any rudeness!

If it is possible, I would like to request a drawing of my 2 original characters!!

One is a white haired sorcerer named 「Pal」!

The other is a wolf boy swordsman named 「Two」!

I would like to leave the idea and composition up to you! Please draw freely!

The attached Google Drive has images of them separated into folders!


Is it okay to also request a version with a transparent background or something like the PSD file? It is not mandatory, but it would be nice to have.

I have doubled the amount of the request to account for 2 characters! If the amount is not enough please feel free to send an appeal back! 🙇‍♂️

thank you for your consideration!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lcXOQEdcQzhFNQUhl2B0JtxQTjgtjiDc

Hello! I love your art - especially this one!
https://skeb.jp/@Mono_ma/works/109
https://skeb.jp/@Mono_ma/works/130

I would like a video of my Vtuber with a happy expression, like "Happy you are here!"

Lives on the moon, but can travel to anywhere that has a moon at whatever time, even if it’s a different universe or dimension.

Friendly, supportive, a little bit silly but loves her friends and family and will do her best . Will stick by her friends and family’s side no matter what! Tries to be elegant but can be a bit rough sometimes.

A little bit childish because she is the youngest of her friends but the oldest child of the family.

Has little pet bunnies as her friends that she can summon wherever she wants. Can understand bunnies. She has a bunny form!

The facial expression, background and composition is up to you! I would like to have a background if possible!

I would like the aspect ratio to be 16:9 so I can use it on YouTube for my streams, posting on social media and videos. Thank you!

Intended use
General distribution activities
Video distribution on Youtube, etc.
Use on posting platforms
Use on social networking sites
Commercial use for online prints, goods, etc.

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the layered data of the person and the background. Please let us know if there are any items that are not acceptable. Thank you for your time, but we would be happy to accept your proposal. Thank you for your consideration.

Hello again! Thank you so much for the adorable animation for my previous request!

This time, I want to commission 2 chibis of my vtuber Ria and my boyfriend's vtuber!
I want this to be used as a "Happy New Year!" image, so please draw us in suitable traditional Japanese clothing. The designs do not have to be complicated. Please draw freely!

Characters:
Ria: a cute and happy chimera girl. There is a heart in the pattern of her tail. Please don't draw the blue part of the hair too dark. It is a light blue! Height: 168cm. Reference: https://imgur.com/a/Ly6j8VW
Lyonia: A calm and reserved prince with a nice voice. Hair color is dark ash brown with light purple highlights. There is a small ponytail. Height: 175cm. Reference: https://imgur.com/a/SOmZalq

Expression: Happy expressions for both characters. Maybe We can draw on X and O shapes on each other's faces with ink brushes.

Outfit: A yukata for Lyonia. A furisode for Ria. Please draw freely!

Background/scene: Please draw any kind of suitable background that reflects "New Year"!

If it's okay, I would like to request the characters to be separated from the background. Thank you very much for your consideration! Happy Holidays!
